summary: Lantmännen Seed BV is a potato and triticale breeding company at Emmeloord in the Netherlands. It develops potato varieties, which Agrico sells and introduces to the market. It has been wholly owned by the Swedish farmers' cooperative Lantmännen since 1993, and breeding at the farm began in 1949.
founded: 1949 (farm and breeding begun by Firma Geertsema)
ownership: 100% subsidiary of the Swedish farmers' cooperative Lantmännen since 1993
products: Table potato varieties for Southern Europe and North Africa
Varieties for the French fries industry
Salad, fine-textured and baker potato varieties

plants.capacity_as_stated: 48 hectares of clay soil and own greenhouse

markets: Table potatoes for Southern Europe and North Africa
Salad, fine-textured and baker potato markets
facts: Eight people work at the company
Farms 48 hectares of flat clay soil
About 250 crosses and about 60,000 seeds sown each year
Joint trials with Agrico last six years
Named Lantmännen Seed since 2020; SW Seed (2004), Lantmännen SW Seed (2009)
